invariants.rationale: The instantTime parameter typically denotes the transaction or commit instant and is expected to be non-null and non-empty for meaningful operation.
The records list must be provided and non-null to perform an insert operation.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to execute the insert operation.
If records is not null, its size must be non-negative as per the List contract.
If instantTime is not null, it should not be all whitespace, ensuring it represents a valid identifier.
